summary: This directory manages the core analytical logic for evaluating and scoring directory structures within a package, providing tools to interpret package facts and rank directory components based on calculated metrics.
responsibilities: Analyze package structures to extract meaningful facts
Rank directory hierarchies based on analytical scoring
relationships: Package facts provide the raw data required by the analysis tools to calculate directory importance scores.
Ranking algorithms rely on the scoring logic to determine the relative priority of different directory structures.
designDecisions: Centralized export of analytical utilities and data structures
Decoupled scoring logic from data collection
Use of interfaces to define consistent package metadata structures
